description: Who bought and who sold a token lately: the wallets that took the most of an ERC-20 from DEX pools and routers (buyers) or sent the most to them (sellers) over recent blocks, from its live Transfer logs on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, with bought, sold, net and transfers. Contracts are left out; plain wallet-to-wallet moves only count in netAll. Use to see who accumulates or dumps a token before you trade it. Example: token=0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to read, 100 to 10000 (default 1800: about 6 hours on Ethereum); on Base, which makes a block every 0.2 s, ten times that (default 18000, about an hour, up to 100000)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

limit.description: Buyers and sellers to return each, 1 to 20 (default 10)

token.description: Token: 0x ERC-20 address, or a ticker such as AERO, DEGEN or USDC

name: token_buyers
title: Token buyers and sellers
